propositions: The documented curl command to install commit-msg hook from linked worktrees resolves to the shared .git/hooks directory and silently overwrites the pre-commit wrapper rather than chaining to it.

When the Gerrit hook installer clobbers the pre-commit wrapper, the 50/72 commit message rule and Change-Id stamping both fail, but the failure is invisible until git push gerrit rejects a commit many commits later in a different worktree.

The installation must be made idempotent, non-destructive, and cwd-independent by installing to commit-msg.legacy when a pre-commit wrapper exists, and refusing loudly when an unsafe overwrite would occur.
Documentation in AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md must remove instructions to curl over $(git rev-parse --git-path hooks/commit-msg) and instead direct users to the single idempotent path of make hooks.
